thecal cells express the NGF receptor, trkA, and that the neurotrophins, NGF and BDNF, stimulate steroidogenesis, PGI2 formation, and the proliferation of thecal cells.

The main takeaway from our work is that
NGF is synthesized in the ovary and may play a direct role in the process of ovulation by affecting thecal cell function.
